title: Onye Na-ewu Nzọpụta nke Na-eguzosi Ike
intro: Onye a, onye nwere nnukwu ndidi na nkwenye siri ike, raara ọtụtụ afọ nye ọrụ Chineke, na-eche ihu nlelị na ịjụ ya mgbe niile. Akụkọ ha bụ ihe akaebe siri ike nke okwukwe n'agbanyeghị enweghị nkwenye siri ike, nke mechara mee ihe dị mkpa nke gbanwere ụwa.
clues: E tinyere m ogologo oge dị egwu n'ime ndụ m n'ịkpọ ndị m ka ha fee Allah.
Ndị m na-akwa m emo ma na-ebo m ebubo mmejọ na ara doro anya.
E nyere m iwu ka m wuo ihe yiri ihe na-adịghị ahụkebe nye obodo m nke na-enweghị ala.
Ọ bụ naanị mmadụ ole na ole kwenyere ma sonyere mụ na ezinụlọ m n'ihe owuwu pụrụ iche a.
Ebu m ụzọ abụọ nke ihe niile dị ndụ n'ime ụgbọ mmiri ahụ, dịka Allah gwara m.
Oké idei mmiri juru ụwa, zọpụta naanị ndị mụ na ha nọ n'ime ụgbọ mmiri m, ebe nwa m nwoke nwụrụ n'ihi na o kweghị.

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: E ji ọrụ ebube zọpụta ndị ya
E ji égbè eluigwe tie ndị ya ihe

arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
